concepts.name: Driver
concepts.definition: A Formula 1 driver identified by full name (forename + surname) or driverRef.

concepts.name: Constructor
concepts.definition: A Formula 1 team/constructor.

concepts.name: Race
concepts.definition: A Formula 1 Grand Prix event, identified by raceId or name.

concepts.name: Circuit
concepts.definition: A racing circuit with location and coordinates.

concepts.name: RaceResult
concepts.definition: A driver's result in a specific race, including position, points, time, laps.
concepts.aggregation: one row per driver per race

concepts.name: ConstructorResult
concepts.definition: Points scored by a constructor in a race.

concepts.name: DriverStanding
concepts.definition: Cumulative driver championship standings after a race.
concepts.aggregation: latest value per driver per season

concepts.name: ConstructorStanding
concepts.definition: Cumulative constructor championship standings after a race.
concepts.aggregation: latest value per constructor per season

concepts.name: Qualifying
concepts.definition: Qualifying session results for a driver in a race.
concepts.aggregation: one row per driver per race

concepts.name: LapTime
concepts.definition: Lap-by-lap timing data for drivers in a race.

concepts.name: PitStop
concepts.definition: Pit stop events with duration for each driver in a race.

concepts.name: Status
concepts.definition: The finishing status of a driver in a race (e.g., finished, accident, mechanical failure).

concepts.name: Accident
concepts.definition: A race result where the driver's status indicates an accident.

concepts.name: FinishedRace
concepts.definition: A race result where the driver completed the race (time is not null).

concepts.name: NotFinishedRace
concepts.definition: A race result where the driver did not finish (time is null).

concepts.name: DriverNationality
concepts.definition: The nationality of a driver.

concepts.name: ConstructorNationality
concepts.definition: The nationality of a constructor.

concepts.name: DriverDOB
concepts.definition: Driver's date of birth.

concepts.name: CircuitCoordinates
concepts.definition: Latitude and longitude of a circuit.

concepts.name: CircuitCountry
concepts.definition: Country where a circuit is located.

concepts.name: RaceYear
concepts.definition: The year a race took place.

concepts.name: RaceDate
concepts.definition: The date a race took place.

concepts.name: DriverRef
concepts.definition: Short reference name for a driver.

concepts.name: ConstructorURL
concepts.definition: Website URL for a constructor.

concepts.name: DriverURL
concepts.definition: Website URL for a driver.

caveats.statement: Some race results have NULL time, meaning the driver did not finish; filtering on time IS NOT NULL is needed for finished drivers.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE time IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Accidents are recorded with statusId = 3, but other statuses may also indicate incidents; verify status meaning before counting.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT statusId, status FROM status WHERE statusId = 3;

caveats.statement: Driver full name is split across forename and surname; queries must concatenate or filter both.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT forename, surname FROM drivers WHERE surname = 'Hamilton';

caveats.statement: Race names may repeat across years; always filter by year or raceId to avoid ambiguity.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT name, COUNT(*) FROM races GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

evidence.result: [["Abu Dhabi Grand Prix", 9], ["Argentine Grand Prix", 20], ["Australian Grand Prix", 33]]

caveats.statement: Circuit coordinates are stored as separate lat and lng columns; both must be selected.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Silverstone Circuit';

caveats.statement: Pit stop duration is in milliseconds; convert to seconds for readability if needed.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT duration, milliseconds FROM pitStops LIMIT 5;

caveats.statement: Fastest lap speed may be NULL for some races; filter out NULLs when finding max.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE fastestLapSpeed IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Constructor nationality is stored in constructors table; 'British' is a nationality value.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT nationality FROM constructors WHERE nationality = 'British';

caveats.statement: Driver date of birth is in drivers.dob; year extraction needed for age filters.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT dob FROM drivers WHERE surname = 'Hamilton';

caveats.statement: Qualifying results may have NULL q1, q2, or q3 for drivers eliminated early; handle NULLs.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying WHERE q1 IS NULL;
